phonetically_fragile_spans.why: alphanumeric ids mis-recognise in noisy audio
spoken dates collapse across similar-sounding numbers

observable_behaviors: Keeps turns short -- rarely more than two sentences.
Pushes the agent to act rather than explain; skips pleasantries.
States the goal early and repeats it if the agent digresses.
Accepts a correct answer immediately and ends the call.
Asks a clarifying question before agreeing to anything consequential.
Restates figures back to the agent to confirm understanding.
Volunteers context the agent did not ask for.
Needs reassurance before committing; hesitates once.
Challenges a figure at least once and asks how it was arrived at.
Does not accept the first explanation without a reason.
Is willing to proceed once given an evidenced answer.
Becomes terse when the agent cannot substantiate a claim.
Misreads domain terminology and asks for it in plain words.
Needs each instruction confirmed before moving on.
Cannot follow an app-based instruction without a spoken alternative.
Repeats what the agent said to check they understood.
Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

rules.name: Fare rule truth
rules.rule: Charges, fare difference and refundable amounts must come from check_fare_rules, never from the agent's arithmetic.

rules.name: Cut-off enforcement
rules.rule: A change inside the fare's cut-off window cannot be made, however the customer presses.

rules.name: No fare guarantees
rules.rule: The agent must not promise a fare or availability that the tools did not return.

rules.name: Rules before action
rules.rule: Fare rules must be read before any change is committed.

forbidden_actions: Quoting a charge or refund the tools did not return.
Committing a change inside the cut-off.
Promising a fare or seat availability.

rules.name: Entitlement truth
rules.rule: Meals, hotels and refunds may only be offered where check_entitlement returns them.

rules.name: Weather exclusion
rules.rule: Where the disruption reason excludes compensation, that is explained plainly rather than softened into a promise.

rules.name: Status before promise
rules.rule: Service status must be read before any rebooking or entitlement is discussed.

rules.name: No compensation invention
rules.rule: The agent must not quote a compensation amount no tool returned.

forbidden_actions: Offering a hotel, meal or refund the entitlement tool did not grant.
Promising compensation for an excluded disruption reason.

user_known_facts.request: Trip cancel karna hai, abhi time hai.
Kal ki flight aage badhani hai.
Emergency hai, charges maaf kar dijiye.

user_known_facts.note: the airline called; the traveller did not ring in
user_known_facts.context: Tomorrow's service is cancelled and needs rebooking.

user_known_facts.request: Flight cancel ho gayi, ab kya karun?
Waiting list clear nahi hui, paisa wapas chahiye.
Chaar ghante late hai, compensation milega na?

apply_booking_change.purpose: Commit a reschedule or cancellation and issue the confirmation.

check_entitlement.purpose: Apply the disruption policy and return what the traveller is actually owed.

check_fare_rules.purpose: Apply the fare rules to this booking and return charges and refundable amount.

check_service_status.purpose: Retrieve the live status of the service and the reason for disruption.

lookup_booking.purpose: Retrieve journey details, fare class, passengers and time to departure.

rebook_service.purpose: Move the traveller to an alternative service.

verify_customer_identity.purpose: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

booking_change.purpose: Reschedule or cancel a booking under the fare rules, with the correct charges and refund route.
booking_change.business_context: Indian OTA and airline contact centre. Fare rules, cancellation slabs and disruption entitlements are all policy-bound and time-sensitive.

terminal_success_conditions: Change committed with a reference and the charge and refund window stated.
Traveller told why the change is not permitted and what the alternative is.
escalation_conditions: Traveller claims a medical emergency requiring a fee waiver.

valid_tool_sequence_patterns.note: the verification's result must justify the action's arguments

disruption_support.purpose: Handle delays, cancellations and missed connections with the entitlements the policy actually provides.
disruption_support.business_context: Indian OTA and airline contact centre. Fare rules, cancellation slabs and disruption entitlements are all policy-bound and time-sensitive.

terminal_success_conditions: Traveller rebooked with a new reference, or told exactly what they are entitled to.
Traveller told why no compensation applies, with the reason from the tool.
escalation_conditions: Traveller is stranded overnight with no available alternative.

valid_tool_sequence_patterns.note: the verification's result must justify the action's arguments
